evidence_scope: 1200 exposed frozen LOCAL-v1 Q3 worlds; local simulation, not blind and not official Windows execution
question: Does choosing a certified clear point from the complete safe action region reduce full-task time versus always using the minimum-enclosing-circle center?

cases.cluster_definition: same integer case seed across the 12 scenario groups
cases.paired_execution: both arms execute each identical serialized world and deterministic error field

single_factor.common_policy: B3, SHA256 e6a066..., with discovery, localization, measurement choice, multi-disk coverage, scheduling, failed-clear recovery and all other configuration unchanged
single_factor.full_C_clear: retain B3 lens_clear=route: after MEC radius <= 20 m certifies one-clear feasibility, choose a point in intersection over feasible-polygon vertices of closed 20 m disks, using current position and route successor
single_factor.mec_center: only when route_clear_point is invoked with MEC radius <= 20 m and an active feasible polygon, return the MEC center; for every other invocation call the original method
single_factor.excluded_from_switch: near-result same-location clears, uncertified optical trials, adaptive multi-disk cell centers/order, discovery, bearings, polygon updates, measurement decisions, route order, recovery and exit logic
single_factor.implementation_hook: runtime Q3 MRO method _P3._LensSpatial.route_clear_point(center, radius, original)

metrics.primary: paired per-world seconds per cleared source; mean across all 1200 worlds
metrics.uncertainty: deterministic 20000-replicate nonparametric bootstrap over 100 seed clusters, retaining all 12 scenario rows in every sampled cluster
metrics.regressions: retain and report the 20 largest positive full-minus-center seconds/source rows and counts by scenario

gates.valid_time_comparison: both arms clear all sources, exit by user_exit and have no error on all 1200 worlds
gates.geometry_audit: every selected one-clear point in both arms is within 20+1e-8 m of every feasible-polygon vertex; every center-arm point equals the MEC center
gates.integrity: all registered input hashes and frozen evaluation verification pass before and after execution
gates.headline_time_gate: full-minus-center seed-cluster bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint < 0 after all validity, geometry and integrity gates pass
gates.failure_policy: if any completeness, certified-action or integrity check fails, do not rank task time; preserve all rows and report the failure
gates.interpretation_if_gate_fails: retain the earlier state-level geometry advantage only; do not claim stable full-task acceleration

truth_boundary.planner_interface: InterfaceOnly exposes enter, measure, clear and exit only
truth_boundary.case_truth_usage: evaluation layer alone constructs LocalEnv and computes completion metrics after the run
truth_boundary.candidate_inputs: candidate wrappers receive no case id, seed, source count, source coordinates, source radius, true direction or test-group label
